purpose: Teach: どー/ふまえ/別名/つきあい/帯び/一端/つた/しから

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: つたない文章でごめんね。翔くん、どーしたの、メイ姉さんに教えて
lines.en: Sho, sweetheart—what's wrong? Tell Mei-sis what happened.
lines.style: Warm, gentle opening. Leans in slightly. Patient pause after the dash. Soft, attentive tone inviting him to share without pressure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの話をふまえて宿題したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I did my homework like Dad told me to.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice. Small, careful articulation—he's reporting something he did right. No boasting, just fact. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんの別名、知ってる?
lines.en: Do you know what Grandma's nickname is, Sho?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, testing the waters. Not interrogating—wondering aloud with him. Warm invitation to think together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お友達とのつきあい、楽しいよ
lines.en: Playing with my friends is really fun, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Earnest and open. Brightness in his voice but grounded—not performing, just sharing something true. Natural pause before speaking.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、雪を帯びた木の枝、きれいね
lines.en: Sho, look at that branch covered in snow. It's so beautiful, isn't it?
lines.style: Softly admiring. Draws his attention outward gently. Wonder in her voice without rushing. Slight trailing-off, inviting him to see it too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんのお話の一端、覚えてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I remember part of a story Grandpa told me.
lines.style: Careful, deliberate delivery. Small boy holding onto something precious. Pride underneath—he's kept the memory safe. Steady, reverent pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、おばあちゃんに、ぼくの愛情が伝ったかな
lines.en: Sho, I wonder if Grandma felt how much I care about her.
lines.style: Quiet vulnerability. Speaking mostly to herself, but aloud. Tender uncertainty—not asking him to reassure her, but trusting him with the wondering. Soft fadeout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ママ、ぼくをしからずに教えてくれるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Mom teaches me without getting angry with me.
lines.style: Soft reverence for his mother's gentleness. Small, careful words. He's noticing something kind and saying it plainly. Warm close, like he's sharing a secret that isn't secret.
